type 'widgets' is a collection and declares no 'folder:' — say which folder holds its records, or declare it 'shape: single-document'.
type 'widgets' declares 'id.style: roman-numeral', which no id check reads. The styles the tool applies are 'literal', 'mnemonic', 'numbered', 'slug'.
type 'widgets' declares 'index.order: newest-first', which the generator does not read. An index is written 'ascending', 'descending'.

type 'widgets' declares 'tier: experimental', and '_tiers.yaml' declares no such tier. Tier decides how a document behaves and is written into the frontmatter of every record of the type; the tiers are 'decided', 'normative', 'descriptive', 'procedural', 'observed'.
type 'widgets' has a 206-character 'summary:'; the limit is 120. It is rendered as a table cell — the fuller account belongs on widgets.md.
type 'widgets' declares no 'goes-here:' — say what a contributor has in hand when this type is the answer, in one line the taxonomy and the corpus index can be generated from.
type 'widgets' declares no 'lineage.prior-art:' — name what the type is nearest to, or say that nothing established fits. Claiming an ancestor a type does not have is worse than admitting none.
